about: The room page's VIBE meter (the 5-second clock, the language a message counts as, the score with its combo and hype, the card that explains it, and the one effect that answers a new message with the logo hop, the join cut-in, confetti and the floating points) to hooks/use-vibe.ts. The table holds for the tree of the commit that added it (git log --diff-filter=A -- scripts/step6/tables/web-vibe-hook.json): later moves take more lines out of the page. From the repo root, with that commit checked out in <folder>: node scripts/step6/web-move-check.mjs scripts/step6/tables/web-vibe-hook.json --root <folder> --strict-indent, and node scripts/step6/hook-order.mjs "apps/web/app/room/[roomId]/page.tsx" --root <folder> --base 07a97f1 --strict
